title: The Novena to St. Jude
description: Novena to St. Jude, patron of difficult causes · 9 days, ~5 min/day

steps.title: Sign of the Cross
steps.versicle: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

steps.title: Novena Intention
steps.prompt: Entrust to St. Jude the cause that seems beyond all hope, and wait on God's answer in trust.

st_jude_novena.text:
Most holy Apostle, St. Jude,
faithful servant and friend of Jesus,
the Church honors and invokes you universally
as the patron of hopeless cases,
of things almost despaired of.
Pray for me, I am so helpless and alone.

Intercede with God for me
that He bring visible and speedy help
where help is almost despaired of.
Come to my assistance in this great need
that I may receive the consolation
and help of heaven in all my necessities,
tribulations, and sufferings,
particularly [mention your request],
and that I may praise God with you and all the saints
forever.

I promise, O blessed St. Jude,
to be ever mindful of this great favor
granted me by God
and to always honor you
as my special and powerful patron,
and to gratefully encourage devotion to you.
Amen.
st_jude_novena.latin:
Sanctissime Apostole, Sancte Iuda,
fidelis serve et amice Iesu,
Ecclesia te honorat et invocat universaliter
tanquam patronum casuum desperatorum,
rerum fere desperatarum.
Ora pro me, tam inops et solus sum.

Intercede apud Deum pro me
ut Ipse adferat visibile et veloce auxilium
ubi auxilium fere desperatur.
Veni in auxilium meum in hac magna necessitate
ut consolationem accipiam
et auxilium caeli in omnibus necessitatibus meis,
tribulationibus et passionibus,
praesertim [mentio petitionem tuam],
et ut Deum laudem tecum et omnibus sanctis
in perpetuum.
Amen.
st_jude_novena.source: Traditional Novena Prayer to St. Jude

hail_mary.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death.
Amen.
hail_mary.latin:
Ave Maria, gratia plena, Dominus tecum.
Benedicta tu in mulieribus,
et benedictus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
Sancta Maria, Mater Dei,
ora pro nobis peccatoribus,
nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.
Amen.

glory_be.text:
Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.
glory_be.latin:
Gloria Patri, et Filio,
et Spiritui Sancto,
sicut erat in principio,
et nunc, et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum.
Amen.

sjd_thanksgiving.text: St. Jude, apostle of Jesus and patron of the hopeless: I thank thee, with all the angels and saints, for thy unfailing intercession, and I will make known the mercy of God received through thee. Amen.

schedule_note.note: The weekly novena: due Wednesdays per the brief's pinned weekday. The session is a single static session (the weekly tradition prays the same exercise every week, continuing week to week); the pack embeds the committed companion import's Traditional Novena Prayer to St. Jude in preference to the modern copyrighted novena cards.
